description: Synthetic API examples for UI integration; these are not real task results.

session.renew: GET /ui/ with credentials:same-origin, then read meta[name=csrf-token] from HTML
session.cookies: Both gateway and worker cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict; no token form.

creation_retry.key: Optional client_request_id: 1..128 ASCII letters, digits, underscore, hyphen or dot. The UI generates one ID per logical creation and keeps it across transport retries.
creation_retry.atomicity: SQLite commits the created resource and an operation-scoped creation_requests record together. Replay is checked before allocating another temporary directory.
creation_retry.replay: The same endpoint, ID and body values return the same resource. Object-key ordering does not matter. Keep the complete body unchanged on retry.

conditions: The same endpoint and ID are reused with different body values.
The referenced project has been archived or its resource is unavailable.

creation_retry.restore: Adding an archived path deliberately uses a NEW client_request_id. An old transport retry must not restore an archived project.

create_project.restore: A new creation request for an existing archived path restores its existing ID and history, preserving its stored access mode.

create_standalone_chat.semantics: This creates a conversation workspace. Create its conversation with POST /chats. The actual system-temp path is generated by the server and persists across application restarts.
create_standalone_chat.isolated: Forces approval/workspace-write independently of composer or global defaults. Temp alone does not isolate all computer reads.
create_standalone_chat.full_access: Explicit confirmation is required. Forces yolo/danger-full-access. The working directory and displayed diff still cover only the chat folder.
create_standalone_chat.missing_folder: System cleanup can remove a temp folder. History remains; starting work reports a missing folder rather than recreating it silently.

remove_project.semantics: Archives the project and hides its chats without deleting filesystem content or stored history. History is accessible again after restoring the path.

busy.reason: Active or recovering work prevents archival.

create_chat.retry: Reuse the ID and exact body values after a lost response. Replay can return a later state of the same chat; it never creates a second chat. See creation_retry.

start.retry: Reuse client_request_id on a transport retry; returned state may advance. New commands use a new ID.

state.merge: Missing messages or changes means omitted, never empty. Selected task previews have messages_has_more/changes_has_more. Use paginated reads for complete details.

history.semantics: Times are Unix seconds; unavailable historical measurements are null. files/added/removed are net differences from this run's baseline. touched_files includes observed edits later reverted.

run_details.pagination: Each collection has its own opaque cursor. Supply messages_cursor, changes_cursor, change_history_cursor or api_events_cursor. Generic cursor applies to all collections; limits are 1..200.

provider_status.meaning: Assignments persist between HTTP requests. in_flight counts active requests. Zero main_count and auxiliary_count means unreserved; cooldown, model compatibility and token budget still determine availability.
provider_status.token_semantics: total_tokens here is local admission pressure: reported usage + active reservations + estimates for unreported requests. It is not a billed-usage measurement. The rolling window and unfinished estimates survive proxy restart; role reservations are recovered separately.

provider_limits.validation: Integer values only: 0 < soft < hard <= tokens_per_minute <= 1000000000. An update preserves other existing provider settings.
provider_limits.routing: At soft, prefer another compatible API; if all are above soft, continue below hard. Do not admit a request whose reservation would exceed hard. Wait within the configured budget or return 429/Retry-After. Existing streams are not interrupted. Calls outside this proxy are invisible.
